response.justification: Bogdan has extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-adjacent technologies, plus strong architecture and open-source contributions, but his title of 'Senior' and 10+ years of experience far exceed the entry-level role, raising concerns about fit, salary expectations, and potential disengagement; additionally, his German language skill is basic, which may hinder on-site collaboration in Berlin.
strengths: Deep TypeScript and Node.js expertise across multiple production systems
Proven fullstack experience with React, REST APIs, and relational databases
Strong open-source contributions and architectural thinking with clean code practices
concerns: Overqualified for entry-level role with 10+ years of senior experience
Basic German proficiency may impede on-site teamwork in Berlin
Extensive background in DLang and embedded systems may signal misalignment with renewable energy tech focus
